title: Adjustment Direction
description: The only direction a seller may move an adjustable term. Experimental in AdCP 3.3 (media_buy.seller_adjustment_allowances). decrease and increase apply to numeric values, earlier and later to timestamps.

enumDescriptions.decrease: The new numeric value MUST be lower than the current one. A reduce-only budget uses this.
enumDescriptions.increase: The new numeric value MUST be higher than the current one. It is never valid on a term that raises what the buyer pays.
enumDescriptions.earlier: The new timestamp MUST be earlier than the current one.
enumDescriptions.later: The new timestamp MUST be later than the current one. A creator or launch date that must not move up uses this.
